method.input: Equal prepared GenericRowData/BinaryRowData and Arrow; both NULL modes; BOOLEAN, all four signed widths and DECIMAL(18,2)/(19,19)/(38,18) truth producers, independent CAST/TRY_CAST inputs, modern/legacy casts and qualified formatting/casing.
method.native_timer: Inside Rust after import and before export; production Calc, output consumption, formatting, allocation and conversions remain timed. Perimeter JNI/C Data and transposes are excluded only from this prepared function gate.
method.previous: Actual preceding encoder/helper and archived native DSO/executable with identical production TableConfig/fixture/data/resources. Prepared setup proves the previous fallback reason and candidate function descriptor with no JVM evaluators. Independent stock controls run in both processes.
method.pipeline: Nine bounded million-row source/blackhole configurations. Two warmups and five alternating measurements per engine; submission/startup, JNI and both perimeter transposes retained. before_observation: Each positive invocation first compares the complete first-query 5003-row map/schema, then fails the native-route assertion. Subsequent queries inside a failed invocation are not reached. Two retained-route/catalog controls per release/JDK pass.

native_runtime_qualification.method: Fresh release Rust core qualification includes independent sort-based string-extrema oracles, sliced/independent NULL masks, all-NULL/empty arrays, scalar arrays, output ownership, and standard Display/truncation/padding formatting oracles with shared sliced validity.

profile.method: Five-second native process sample of initial INT CAST/TRY_CAST pair; counts are inclusive sampled frames, not elapsed-time percentages.
profile.observation: 927 initial extrema frames include 681 zip frames and 226 comparison-index frames. IntegerString subtrees include 698 formatting frames. First one-pass StringBuilder attempt still loses bulk controls. Final extrema select borrowed slices into one offset/value buffer with strict union validity; integer formatting uses a reusable itoa stack buffer and shares source validity, preserving truncation and CHAR padding. Uniform winners share input buffers after comparing valid rows once. An additional Boolean-text proof selects the strict Boolean extremum before formatting once, eliminating redundant string producers when all operands have the same verified Boolean spelling, including exact matching Boolean-word literals produced by constant folding. Other literal spellings/padded CHAR values retain text comparison.

limitations: This bounded ASCII proof does not replace Java UTF-16/cached source STRING ordering or dynamic-trim semantics; broad source-representation issue stays open.
Prepared results do not imply universal complete-job acceleration. All slower tiny/full-job cells and independent stock variability remain.

One qualification run was interrupted after a DECIMAL folded-literal bulk loss; all completed cells remain with their original encoder provenance. Incomplete process output is not presented as a complete trial.
Released upstream extrema tests are unchanged stock oracles. Focused local qualification does not replace exact-head hosted CI.
